name: menu-icon-button
title: MenuIconButton
description: A MENU behind a single glyph: the row's `⋮`, the card's overflow, the extra actions a toolbar has no room to name. It is <MenuButton>'s pair, and the split between them is the same one the system already makes between `Button` and `IconButton`: a control with no words in it has to carry a name and a tooltip, and a separate component is what makes that unavoidable rather than remembered. Folding it
docs: Part of the AI Design System. Its full contract — every prop, its allowed values and what each one means — is at https://github.com/axdes/AI-Design-system/blob/main/registry/MenuIconButton.json
